dct_title_s: Tabula geographica, in qua Paradisus, nec non regiones, urbes, oppida, et loca describuntur : quorum in Genesi mentio fit
dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Miliaria Germanica, Duytsche mylen” and “Leucae horariae, Uren gaens.”
Map appears as inset, surrounded by pictorial vignettes depicting scenes from Genesis, including the Garden of Eden.
Maps in Bibles, 1500-1600: An illustrated catalogue, 10.
Dutch title: Geographische beschryvinge des Paradys, oft Luft-hofs Heden, metgaders der landen, Steden en plaetsen, der welcker vermelt word int boeck der Scheppinge.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 4.
